fire: Heat the oil in a pan until it is very hot.
Warm the skillet over high heat until hot, then add the steak.
Simmer the soup until it is piping hot all the way through.
Make sure the grill is hot before you lay down the fish.
Serve the curry while it is still hot.
Bake for ten minutes, until the filling is hot and bubbling.
Reheat the leftovers until they are hot in the middle.
Pour the hot syrup slowly over the beaten egg whites.
quiet: Heat the oil in a pan until it starts to shimmer.
Warm the skillet over high heat, then add the steak.
Simmer the soup until the carrots are tender.
Make sure the grill is clean before you lay down the fish.
Serve the curry with rice and fresh coriander.
Bake for ten minutes, until the filling is golden and bubbling.
Reheat the leftovers in the microwave for two minutes.
Pour the thick syrup slowly over the beaten egg whites.
